reason: Test the bounded A-panel change first: it directly targets the requested reuse question and is distinct from the measured panel wrappers and traversals, though its cache benefit is unverified. Next test one Strassen wrapper using the verified 256 helper; it has no complete-wrapper measurements and carries numerical risk. The scratch_lifetime and cache_blocking proposals largely describe the same three-buffer Strassen schedule, so test the base schedule before the one-allocation variant. Then try the distinct fused transpose and SME mapping or issue-order changes; their expected benefits are uncertain, and prior related schedule changes did not promote. The paired-load proposal has unresolved instruction legality. The remaining proposals either duplicate the proposed Strassen wrapper or affect only general-size paths outside the n=512 timing workload.
